name: Stars of Aristella
source:
The stories your Mimi told were true. After making a wish upon a shooting star, Aristella blesses you with a Champion – but to your surprise, two other stars are drawn to your wish as well.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
